leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Vue component with a template, script, and style section
Initialize and bind data properties to display dynamic content in the card
Apply computed properties to manipulate and format card data
Configure props to pass data from a parent component to the card
Implement event handling to control user interactions with the card
Integrate conditional rendering to show or hide card elements based on state
Render the card component within a parent component and pass required data
